header: A numbered list where the position is the point
lead: The order is the order of the child records — drag to re-rank. The position numbers are drawn by the list itself, so nothing has to be renumbered by hand when a row moves.
note: Use Bar Comparison when the distance between the values matters more than the order, and Figures List when the rows are simply labelled numbers.

metrics.title: First place
metrics.text: The detail line under a name is optional and stays secondary.

metrics.title: Twentieth place, at most
metrics.text: Past twenty, a ranking becomes a directory.
